Adventurer's Peak is a challenge mode

with a ranking system that is updated every week.


You can challenge 2 bosses to test your strength.


Updated at 5 AM (JST) every Sunday.

"Damage Score" increases based on

the damage dealt to the boss within the time limit.


Additionally, bonuses will be added to Damage Score if

certain conditions are met during the battle.

[00ffff]♦No Items Used Bonus[ffffff] (Score +5%)
Never use items during the battle.


[00ffff]♦Zero Status Ailment[ffffff] Bonus (Score +10%)
Never receive any status ailments from the target's attacks.


[00ffff]♦No Knockout[ffffff] Bonus (Score +15%)
Never get knocked out during the battle.


[00ffff]♦Zero Damage[ffffff] (Score  +20%)
Never take any damage from the target's attacks.
[ffff00]*Zero Damage includes cases where you take 0 damage or activate certain skills.
(See the next page for details.)

[ffff00]*Skills that count as "Zero Damage":



[ffffff]Cross Parry
Magadachi
Bouncing Blade
God Hand
Elegant Poise

Damage scores are automatically registered

in the ranking system.


[ffff64]Rankings are tabulated based on

the category you enter.

♦Solo Category
Compete for the top spot with your character, partner or pet.
[ff0000]*Mercenaries are not allowed.[ffffff]


♦Team Category
Compete for the top spot with 2 or more characters.
[ff0000]*Mercenaries, partners, and pets are not allowed.[ffffff]


♦By role: Attacker/Defender/Supporter/Assister
[ffff64]In the Team Category, players who rank 1st for each role
during the battle will be listed separately in the ranking system.

Players can earn "Glory Shards"

based on their rankings every week.

at the Prize Exchange.
